primary_question: Does person-ROI fine-tuning improve fixed-threshold per-person action recognition relative to pn2 on identical held-out windows?
primary_descriptive_metric: fused macro-F1 over test-supported classes at threshold 0.75
uncertainty_unit: frozen source group; windows within each group remain paired and dependent
uncertainty_estimand: mean group accuracy difference (selected minus baseline), 5000 paired group bootstrap draws, percentile 95% interval
paired_test: two-sided exact sign test on non-tied group accuracy changes; RGB and fused form one Holm-corrected family
limitations: One fine-tuning seed. Group intervals describe empirical sample variation, not training-seed uncertainty or cross-camera generalization. Macro-F1 is descriptive because some action classes have very few independent videos.
